text: {"features":[{"name":"Experience depth","description":"Indicates how much relevant hands-on experience the letter shows in testing, maintaining, launching, and operating production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only a modest floor of relevant experience, with limited production scope and little sense of ownership beyond meeting the baseline."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Clearly meets the minimum with relevant production work, but the tenure or system exposure still feels fairly narrow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents solid relevant experience across several years and multiple production services, including testing, maintenance, and launch work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production depth through broader service exposure or a clear progression from maintenance work into ownership."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys mature, end-to-end engineering experience with extensive tenure and repeated responsibility for launching and operating multiple production systems."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"Shows how central and relevant Go is to the applicant's actual backend engineering work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only as one language in the background without showing what was built with it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States meaningful Go experience, but gives little detail about the systems or responsibilities involved."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go is a primary language for the applicant's production work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Connects Go directly to relevant backend systems or security tooling responsibilities."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Go as the backbone of role-matching work, such as designing and operating backend infrastructure for agents or vulnerability workflows."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"Shows the depth and production relevance of Python experience for services, automation, analysis, or agent work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python at all or only implies very general scripting familiarity."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python briefly, but without concrete responsibility or production context."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States regular Python use for services, tooling, or internal automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes Python as a significant production language for automation, analysis, internal services, or agent layers."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong, production-grade Python ownership and ties it directly to automation or agent systems central to this role."}]},{"name":"AI experience","description":"Demonstrates relevant hands-on experience building, shipping, or operating AI-enabled systems in production.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of AI or LLM experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI exposure or interest, but without clear shipped work or responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building or shipping AI or LLM-based features in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Pairs shipped AI work with operational concerns such as evaluation, trust, hardening, or dependable behavior."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production AI engineering that is clearly relevant to security tooling or agents and demonstrates awareness of reliability or failure modes."}]},{"name":"Security assessment","description":"Demonstrates hands-on ability to assess systems or designs for security issues and follow through on remediation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no concrete evidence of security assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Uses vague security-review language, but does not show real assessment practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States participation in threat modeling, code review, or service security assessments."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes structured assessments across new or existing systems, including documenting findings or validating fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents security assessment as a substantial, repeatable engineering activity with clear method, scope, and remediation follow-through."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"Shows direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, deduplication, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any automation around vulnerability handling or response."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Speaks generally about reducing manual security work, but gives no concrete vulnerability workflow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building some tooling or automation for vulnerability triage or report handling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains a specific vulnerability workflow such as classification, routing, deduplication, or queue reduction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end ownership of meaningful vulnerability-response automation with clear workflow detail and concrete reduction of manual workload."}]},{"name":"Agentic architecture","description":"Demonstrates experience designing systems in which agents act autonomously under explicit controls and supporting infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of agent or agentic-system experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or autonomous tooling at a high level without meaningful architectural detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agent-based systems with clear roles for agents and supporting services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains a concrete architecture such as Python agents bounded by Go services, contracts, logging, permissions, or constraints."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows mature, role-relevant agentic design thinking that emphasizes autonomy, guardrails, auditability, and infrastructure strategy."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic evidence","description":"Demonstrates practical strength in data structures and algorithms through concrete engineering examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of data-structure or algorithmic strength beyond general engineering claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims strong algorithmic ability, but without a concrete technical example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one clear example of using an algorithm or data-structure choice to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives a technically specific example that links algorithmic judgment to a clear performance, scale, or tractability gain."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially strong and current algorithmic judgment through highly credible examples of redesigning core logic, hot paths, graph work, streaming work, or similarly role-relevant systems."}]},{"name":"Offensive-security signal","description":"Provides evidence of attacker-minded security practice through certifications, CTF performance, or comparable hands-on offensive work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no offensive-security signal at all."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Offers a light signal such as casual CTF participation or a baseline security certification without stronger hands-on evidence."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful hands-on security credibility through regular CTF participation, solid results, or a certification presented as substantive training."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides strong offensive-security evidence such as OSCP-level certification or near-top finishes in competitive CTF events."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Combines rigorous offensive-security validation with clear, sustained practice or achievement, making the attacker perspective especially credible."}]},{"name":"Rigor mindset","description":"Signals care for correctness, guardrails, auditability, and high standards in security-sensitive software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little or no indication of rigor beyond generic competence claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses a general preference for quality or standards, but without concrete practices or examples."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions dependable systems, correctness, or guardrails in a plausible but limited way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives concrete rigor signals such as typed and tested services, bounded actions, auditability, or secure defaults."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a memorable, well-developed philosophy of building security tooling to a higher standard and backs it with concrete engineering habits."}]},{"name":"Role tailoring","description":"Shows how directly the letter connects the applicant's background to the specific duties and needs of this job.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Could fit many generic software roles and shows little evidence of understanding this team's actual work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References security or scale broadly, but does not clearly connect experience to the specific responsibilities in the posting."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects past work to at least one core responsibility such as vulnerability handling, AI agents, or security tooling."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Maps multiple parts of the background to multiple job responsibilities in a targeted way."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates an unusually sharp grasp of the role's charter and responsibility mix, making the fit feel deliberate and precise."}]},{"name":"Security leverage mindset","description":"Articulates a mindset of building systems that scale scarce security expertise, reduce manual toil, and make secure behavior easier for other teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not articulate why security tooling, secure defaults, or scaled automation matter."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses general interest in security impact, but without a clear leverage model."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows awareness that automation can reduce manual work or help other engineers act more securely."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly frames the work as scaling security judgment or making the secure path the default."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Repeatedly and persuasively treats security engineering as leverage, capacity-building, and developer enablement in ways that tightly match the team's mission."}]},{"name":"Partnership orientation","description":"Shows readiness to work closely with security specialists and build tools that serve internal developer users well.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little sign of collaboration or user-service orientation beyond the applicant's own interests."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Uses generic teamwork language, but does not show a concrete partnership mindset."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions working with security engineers or serving developers as a meaningful part of the role."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly emphasizes closeness to users, reducing developer friction, or learning from dedicated security specialists."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Strongly frames impact through partnership with security experts and developer teams, showing empathy for how tooling is actually adopted and used."}]},{"name":"Impact specificity","description":"Uses concrete achievements, outcomes, and examples rather than relying mainly on broad claims about skill.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on generic assertions with little concrete accomplishment or observable result."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few specific tasks, but gives minimal detail about what changed or why it mattered."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides at least one clear example of relevant work and its practical importance."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Offers several concrete examples that show how the applicant improved systems, reduced toil, or solved real problems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently grounds major claims in specific, credible accomplishments and observable outcomes, making the evidence unusually convincing."}]},{"name":"Motivation","description":"Conveys a credible, specific reason this role is a desired and logical next step for the applicant.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States interest in the role with little or no personal rationale."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Gives a thin rationale that rests mainly on company prestige, scale, or generic interest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Offers a plausible personal reason the role fits the applicant's current interests or direction."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a clear rationale that links prior experience or values to why this role is the right next move."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a memorable and authentic explanation that makes the application feel especially intentional and well matched."}]},{"name":"Extra-role initiative","description":"Shows self-directed technical initiative through open-source work, maintained side projects, or other sustained engineering beyond assigned job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions no meaningful technical initiative outside core job responsibilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small or casual side project, but without depth, continuity, or real technical challenge."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some sustained initiative through a maintained utility, occasional upstream patches, or modest project ownership."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates notable initiative through active open-source maintenance or a substantial personal system with real engineering complexity."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional self-directed engineering through ambitious, production-like projects or significant open-source stewardship that clearly deepens role-relevant skills."}]},{"name":"Organization","description":"Presents information in a structure that is easy to follow, logically ordered, and efficient for a hiring reader.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as a loose list of claims with weak progression, making the case harder to absorb."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Is understandable overall, but the flow feels formulaic, choppy, or only lightly connected."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a clear, scannable structure, though some sections still feel boilerplate or loosely linked."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Moves coherently from background to evidence to fit, making the case easy to follow."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Uses an especially crisp and persuasive structure that guides the reader through a memorable, efficient argument."}]},{"name":"Mechanics","description":"Uses correct spelling, grammar, and professional phrasing with few enough errors to preserve credibility.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent or prominent errors, including in high-visibility places, that repeatedly distract and undercut professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains multiple noticeable spelling, grammar, or phrasing errors, but the meaning remains clear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Contains a handful of minor errors or awkward constructions without materially weakening the letter."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Contains only isolated small mistakes and reads as polished overall."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and professionally polished throughout."}]}]}
